title: Can the agent answer route update memory?

nodes.body:
Yes. The `/answer` route can update repository memory when memory is available and `AGENT_MEMORY_POLICY` allows writes.

Evidence:
- [`memory.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/memory.md) says main routes, including `answer`, read/write memory by default.
- [`agent-router.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml) runs `/answer` through `run-agent-task` with `memory_policy: ${{ vars.AGENT_MEMORY_POLICY || '' }}`.
- [`memory-policy.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/memory-policy.ts) defaults empty policy to `enabled`.
- [`run-agent-task/action.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml) commits memory edits only after a clean run, when writes are enabled and memory was mounted.

For this run, I also appended a daily memory note confirming discussion #246: `/answer` can update memory when `AGENT_MEMORY_POLICY` allows writes.
